_comment: The Everest Gauntlet (F4). Two independent solo legs, one config.
THE FRENZY (!thefrenzy): a spawn every interval_seconds, strictly alternating bugs
(odd spawns, name shown) and fish (even spawns, image only). Roll a rarity from
rarity_weights, then pick a random creature of that rarity from the EXISTING pools
in config/bugfrenzy.json and config/fishing.json. Creatures are never defined here.
The leg ends only at required_catches. There is no spawn cap.
THE 101ST KEY (!the101stkey / !unlock / !hint): five keys in order. !unlock only ever
checks the CURRENT key, so the chain cannot be skipped. Two hints per key.
PLACEHOLDER strings below are for the host to fill in. Everything here is editable
without a code change; windows are seconds and must stay under interval_seconds.

frenzy.start_message: PLACEHOLDER - the frenzy has begun. Catch 10 to clear this leg.
frenzy.resume_message: PLACEHOLDER - picking up where you left off.
frenzy.idle_pause_message: PLACEHOLDER - paused because the channel went quiet. Run `!thefrenzy` again to resume.
frenzy.completion_message: PLACEHOLDER - host supplies the frenzy completion text.

hints_exhausted_message: You've already used both hints for this key.
finish_message: # You have completed Season 2's rendition of The Everest Gauntlet!
